kit.role: wall pillars, corner posts, and panel framing trim
kit.rationale: Crisp rectangular mortar grid with clean straight seams and flat regular faces on the vertical posts and the borders around each panel — the unmistakable regular brick courses of stone_bricks, not the random lumps of cobble.

kit.role: infill panels between the stone-brick pillars and the gable field
kit.rationale: Mottled, rounded multi-pebble texture with irregular dark speckles and no straight mortar lines — the random cobblestone face, clearly distinct from the regular bricks framing it.
Dark chocolate-brown boards with tight horizontal plank seams and faint vertical board breaks — the dark, low-contrast grain of spruce_planks rather than the streaky reddish dark_oak.

kit.role: foundation plinth / base course under the walls
kit.rationale: The bottom band reads lighter and flatter than the stone bricks above it, with a smooth uniform grey face and only faint slab seams — the clean unbroken surface of smooth_stone forming the raised footing.

kit.role: double entry doors in the long wall
kit.rationale: Tall two-tone orange-brown leaves with the recessed upper/lower panel split and a visible round handle — the standard oak_door, paired as a double doorway.

unidentified.surface: thin vertical slit near the gable apex
unidentified.reason: A narrow dark vertical opening sits high in the gable; it could be a ladder rung, iron_bars, or a slit window, but the texture is too small and shadowed to name the block honestly.
